## October 8-10: Started on the Basic Design

-Started on a Wokwi model using an ESP32 processor instead of the PCB to get a basic idea of how my project would work out with the PCB

-Started on some short sample code to test out features of the model, such as the screen, will work

-Next, I will physically build the Wokwi model before starting on designing the actual PCB
